embeds.title: BLHA AWARDS NIGHT
embeds.description: Season `[YEAR]` ballots are open. Owners choose the winners.

fields.name: THE AWARDS
fields.value: **GM of the Year** • **Trade of the Year** • **Waiver Wire Award** (best pickup) • **Rookie GM of the Year** (first-season owners) • **Cold Beer Award** (the season's funniest moment)

fields.name: HOW TO VOTE
fields.value: One Discord poll per award in **gm-lounge**, open until **`[TIMESTAMP]`**. One vote per owner per award. Please don't vote for yourself.

fields.name: RESULTS
fields.value: Winners are announced in **hall-of-champions** and kept in the league records.

fields.name: JUST FOR FUN
fields.value: Awards carry no money and change nothing in the standings or the draft.
